_note: The game reads every number in this file: change one here and the game changes. Text fields ('formula', '*Formula') are the readable spec and name the numbers next to them. Research bonuses (e.g. Mandibles +10% attack) live in research.json 'effect'. World speed is set when a world is created (server config), not here.

cost.chamberFormula: baseCost * costFactor^(level - 1)   (costFactor per chamber in chambers.json)
cost._researchNectarToProtein: Research pays part of its Nectar in Protein (Marz, 30 Oct 2026): share of each research's Nectar cost is replaced by proteinPerNectar Protein each. Protein piles up while Nectar is the bottleneck. Research time still comes from the unswapped cost (docs/07-research.md).

gathering._note: One dial for everything a colony gathers itself (docs/03-economy.md): base income, producing chambers, Gardener Minims, forage finds (still only what the party can carry) and aphid herd Nectar. Raid loot, wild-nest stores, quest rewards and storage are not affected. Set to 2 on 2026-10-30 after playtest feedback; 1 is the original pace.

production.perHour: (baseIncome + base * level * levelGrowth^level * (1 + terrainPct/100) * workforceRatio) * gathering.multiplier * worldSpeed

digPlan._note: The dig plan (docs/04-colony.md): chambers lined up behind the dig in progress. Each starts, and is paid for, when the diggers are free and the colony can afford it. 'slots' is how many can wait in line; 'unlock' is what the colony needs first.

distance.formula: same spot: sameSpot; same patch: samePatchBase + samePatchPerSpot * |spotA - spotB|; same region: sameRegionBase + sameRegionPerPatch * |patchA - patchB|; otherwise otherRegionPerRegion * |regionA - regionB|

scouting.detectionFormula: min(1, detectionPerUnitPerScout * defenderUnits * scouts * detectionScentBase^(theirScentReading - yourScentReading))

detail.formula: diff = floor(yourScoutLevel - theirScoutLevel + (scouts - 1) / extraScoutsPerStep). The report shows units from unitsFrom, defenses from defensesFrom, everything from fullFrom; below unitsFrom, resources only.

retreatOptions._note: The fall-back order a raider picks (docs/08-combat.md): after a round in which the raiders have lost at least this percent of their army's worth (Foliage + Protein + Nectar cost), they break off and go home. 0 = fight to the end. It counts as the defender holding.

combat._lootPctOfWild: Wild nests, termite mounds and spider dens give up more when beaten, so a won raid pays in loot rather than mostly in corpses (Marz, 30 Oct 2026). Aphid herds and players use lootPctOfUnprotected.

pvp.lateFoundingBoost: timeMultiplier = lateFoundingMinMultiplier + (1 - lateFoundingMinMultiplier) * min(1, playerPoints / worldMedianPoints)

feeding.formula: extra Protein per unit = extraProteinPct/100 * (unit foliage + protein); time per unit * (1 - timeCutPct/100). Castes only, chosen per batch.

digestion.formula: nectar = floor(protein / proteinPerNectar); hours = protein / (proteinPerHourPerLevel * broodHallLevel) / worldSpeed. Nectar trickles in evenly; stopping refunds the undigested Protein.

gardeners._note: Gardener Minims at home (docs/03-economy.md): each adds pctEach % to the colony's Leaf Garden output, counting at most perLeafGardenLevel per Leaf Garden level. Minims on missions don't count.

desertAnts._note: Desert Ants in a forage party (docs/09-missions.md): every antsPerLuck of them count as one more Foraging Instinct level for that trip (luck and find cap), up to maxLuck.

luck.formula: Each forageLuck level (Foraging Instinct) moves shiftPerLevel points of weight from the takeFrom outcomes, in order, never taking more than (100 - keepPct)% of any one; the moved weight goes to giveToPct (percent shares).

findCap.formula: round((base + perPoint * playerPoints) * (1 + luckPctPerLevel/100 * forageLuck) * gathering.multiplier), and never more than the party can carry

results._note: What each outcome does. cargoPct: [min, max] percent of the find cap, rolled evenly; firstTripCargoPct is used instead on a player's first trip. mixPct: how the find splits across resources. lossPct: [min, max] percent of the party lost, a whole number rolled evenly. returnFactor: multiplier on the trip home. Outcomes not listed do nothing.
